title: LeanTTA: A Backpropagation-Free and Stateless Approach to Quantized Test-Time Adaptation on Edge Devices
abstract: arXiv:2503.15889v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: While there are many advantages to deploying machine learning models on edge devices, the resource constraints of mobile platforms, the dynamic nature of the environment, and differences between the distribution of training versus in-the-wild data make such deployments challenging. Current test-time adaptation methods are often memory-intensive and not designed to be quantization-compatible or deployed on low-resource devices. To address these challenges, we present LeanTTA, a novel backpropagation-free and stateless framework for quantized test-time adaptation tailored to edge devices. translated_title: LeanTTA：一种面向边缘设备上量化测试时自适应的无反向传播、无状态方法
translated_abstract: 尽管在边缘设备上部署机器学习模型具有诸多优势，但移动平台的资源限制、环境的动态特性，以及训练数据与真实场景数据分布之间的差异，使得此类部署充满挑战。现有的测试时自适应方法通常内存开销大，且并未针对量化兼容性或低资源设备部署而设计。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了LeanTTA，一个专为边缘设备量身打造的、无反向传播且无状态的新型量化测试时自适应框架。我们的方法通过在不使用反向传播的情况下动态更新归一化统计量来最小化计算成本，使LeanTTA摆脱了依赖大批量数据和历史数据的常见缺陷，从而在现实部署场景中具有更强的鲁棒性。我们的方法是首个通过组合……来实现进一步计算收益的方法。
tldr: 本文提出LeanTTA框架，通过无反向传播、无状态地动态更新归一化统计量，实现了面向边缘设备的量化测试时自适应，显著降低内存与计算开销且不依赖大批量或历史数据。
en_tdlr: LeanTTA is a backpropagation-free, stateless framework for quantized test-time adaptation on edge devices that dynamically updates normalization statistics, cutting memory and compute costs without relying on large batches or historical data.
